note:
The subject is a gate reporting success when it could not look. The gofmt pre-commit hook read `test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"` and never its exit code: `gofmt -l` writes offending files to stdout and its own errors to stderr, so any failure of gofmt produced an empty substitution, `test -z ""` was true, and the hook exited 0. Not skipped, not red — Passed, asserting it looked. Its window is a fresh clone before `mise trust`, which is a new contributor's first commit (#829).

It is the gate-level form of the defect this repository names most often: a control that cannot fail is a comment. It was found while running the measurement #739 asks for, which is the detail worth keeping — the harness broke first and the hook agreed with it, and `go vet` and `golangci-lint` reddening at the same instant on the same cause is the only reason the gofmt green stood out.

The first mutation restores the defect exactly. The second is the over-correction, and it is mutated because a hook that refuses everything passes the first test and refuses every commit, which teaches `--no-verify` and disarms every other hook at once — this repository has that written down as worse than no gate at all.

Both tests run the hook's own `entry:` line, read out of .pre-commit-config.yaml rather than copied into Go. A test asserting the entry *contains* `||` would pass on any rewrite that kept the characters and lost the property.

mutations.label: the entry goes back to `test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"`, which discards gofmt's exit code. This is the defect verbatim: with no gofmt on PATH the substitution is empty, the test is true, and the hook reports success over code nobody formatted
mutations.find: entry: bash -c 'out=$(gofmt -l .) || { echo "gofmt could not run" >&2; exit 1; }; test -z "$out" || { echo "gofmt needed:"; echo "$out"; exit 1; }'
mutations.replace: entry: bash -c 'test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" || { echo "gofmt needed:"; gofmt -l .; exit 1; }'

mutations.label: the hook refuses whatever it is given, which passes the refusing test and rejects every commit including correctly formatted Go. The shape that teaches `--no-verify`, and `--no-verify` disarms every other hook in this file at once

mutations.replace: entry: bash -c 'out=$(gofmt -l .) || { echo "gofmt could not run" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "gofmt needed:"; echo "$out"; exit 1'
